name: Data notebook
summary: Graph paper, the chart as the hero, figures numbered like a lab notebook, marker highlights.
avoid_for: decks with no data at all

rules.grid: A 30 px graph-paper grid with a margin rule on the left; content on a 900 px column starting after the margin. Charts take the largest box of any direction.
rules.type: Bricolage Grotesque for titles and numerals, IBM Plex Sans for body, IBM Plex Mono for figure captions, axes, sources.
rules.density: Dense is allowed when it is data: one chart per slide, numbered figures, a note under each. Text slides stay short.
rules.accent: The marker: highlighted words get an accent-fill band, the chart message gets the accent mark. Nothing else is coloured.
rules.photo: Shown whole on white photo paper with a thin ink border, caption in mono.
rules.texture: The graph-paper grid only, faint (under 35 % opacity lines), never under a chart's labels in a way that hurts reading.

layouts.cover-a: Logo top-left, the photo on white photo paper, the title large at the bottom with a marker highlight on the accent.
layouts.cover-b: Title first, then the standfirst as a margin note beside the photo.
layouts.list: Title, items with circled numbers in the accent.
layouts.stat: The numeral on a double underline, its label, a context note.
layouts.chart: Short title, numbered figure caption in mono, the chart filling the page, the note under it.
layouts.quote: The quote set large, attribution as a mono note.
layouts.media: Title over the photo on photo paper or a framed screenshot with numbered annotations.
layouts.logos: Title, logos in ink on the grid.
layouts.visual: Title over the SVG drawn in ink with the marker accent.
layouts.cta: Logo top-left, the action large, the URL in mono with a marker underline.
